## Summary
<!-- State what changes and why. Link the issue or decision. -->

## Change type
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Build / CI / maintenance
- [ ] Security / privacy
- [ ] Breaking change

## Scope and implementation
<!-- Describe the affected modules, public contracts and behavior. -->

## Verification evidence
- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass.
- [ ] Build, lint and static checks pass where configured.
- [ ] New behavior has positive, negative and boundary tests.
- [ ] Manual verification is described with environment and steps, where needed.
- [ ] No test, benchmark, screenshot or capability is represented as evidence unless it was actually produced.

## Design and accessibility (when applicable)
- [ ] Uses canonical Duck Black / Yellow tokens; no competing palette was introduced.
- [ ] Keyboard navigation and visible focus are preserved.
- [ ] Contrast and status labels/icons are adequate.
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` is respected.
- [ ] Responsive/native scaling and touch targets were checked.

## Documentation and product claims
- [ ] README and relevant guides match the implementation.
- [ ] Ukrainian / English / Russian variants remain scope-equivalent where supported.
- [ ] Commands and examples were verified or clearly labelled as examples.
- [ ] Feature state is accurate: implemented, verified, experimental, planned or unsupported.
- [ ] Release notes and migration notes are updated where needed.
- [ ] No invented metrics, certifications, testimonials or unsupported marketing claims were added.

## Security, privacy and compatibility
- [ ] Permissions and data access follow least privilege.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, personal data or machine-specific paths are committed.
- [ ] Dependencies and workflow permissions were reviewed.
- [ ] Public APIs, schemas and backward compatibility were considered.
- [ ] Destructive behavior has confirmation, rollback or a documented safety boundary.

## Technical debt and operations
- [ ] New debt is recorded with evidence, owner, risk and next action.
- [ ] Existing debt affected by this PR was updated.
- [ ] Rollback or recovery steps are documented for risky changes.
- [ ] Known limitations and follow-up work are listed.

## Risk and release notes
**Risk level:** Low / Moderate / High / Critical  
**Migration required:** No / Yes — describe  
**Rollback:** Not required / Describe steps  
**Known limitations:** <!-- List or write "None known". -->

## Reviewer checklist
- [ ] Scope is focused and independently reviewable.
- [ ] Implementation matches the stated acceptance criteria.
- [ ] Tests are meaningful and do not merely restate implementation.
- [ ] Documentation does not overstate the delivered capability.
